title: Generation mix v1
description: Generation by fuel for one half-hour. Elexon FUELHH reports MW by BM fuel type (transmission-connected only, so solar and most embedded wind are absent); the Carbon Intensity API reports percentages. Since 1.1.0, imports and storage are net values: negative means net export or pumping.

fuel.description: Normalised fuel category used across sources.

source_fuel_code.description: Fuel code exactly as the source reported it (e.g. CCGT, INTFR, NPSHYD), kept for traceability.

value.description: Net value. Only imports (interconnector export) and storage (pumping) may be negative.
